description: This file contains Pydantic schema definitions for handling API request and response data related to test runs within a test management service. It defines data models for creating, querying, and executing test runs, including their statuses, timestamps, and associated file paths.

classes.name: RunBase
classes.description: Base schema for test run, including optional test file, testcase, and run configuration IDs.

classes.name: RunCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new test run, extending RunBase and adding optional variables.

classes.name: RunTestCaseRequest
classes.description: Schema for requesting execution of a specific test case.

classes.name: RunQueueExecuteRequest
classes.description: Schema for batch executing multiple test files or test cases.

classes.name: RunResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the response details of a test run, including status, timestamps, file paths, and error messages.

classes.name: RunLogsResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving logs related to a test run, including content and presigned URLs.
